bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders or paid parking in marked bays
bays.tariff: Pay-to-park bays — borough-wide tariff (Enfield Council): 15 minutes 90p; 30 minutes £1.70; 1 hour £3.30; 2 hours £6.50; maximum stay 2 hours. Charges apply Monday to Saturday (and on Sundays in Enfield Town) during the hours shown on the bay sign
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app or phone 0330 400 7275) or at a PayPoint shop
